answer.rationale: Roll out shortened, simplified self-serve onboarding: it has confirmed improvements in completion (+13%), time-to-value (-2.1 days), and 30-day retention (+3%), while prior signup simplification also durably lifted SMB activation. Avoid promotional pricing despite the competitor move: the recovered targeted-discount result increased signup and near-term qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, conflicting with the objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue. This will not directly resolve every price-driven churn conversation, but it is the strongest validated sustainable response available without new verification.
